SELECT t.id, t.name, t.create_time, t.update_time, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tag t LEFT JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id LEFT JOIN article a ON a.id = at.article_id AND a.published_version_id IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted = 0
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
GROUP BY t.id, t.name, t.create_time, t.update_time ORDER BY article_count DESC
SELECT t.id, t.name FROM tag t INNER JOIN article_tag at ON at.tag_id = t.id WHERE at.article_id = #{articleId}
